items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: And when I first met him, he had a local account with A&P. And we'd do store interviews.

ctx.x: Hoppy originally worked with Brinkerhoff. That was your secretary?

Yeah. Yeah. He had a small agency, but really creative guy. Really, really sharp. And when I first met him, he had a local account with A&P. And we'd do store interviews. You know. A&P, 8 o'clock coffee. We were promoting 8 o'clock coffee. And the portable I had was a wire recorder. And I edited it. That's dangerous. I edited it. Wire. Yeah. Yeah. I learned how to edit wire. You tied a figure of 8. You tie a figure of 8 knot in it. Pull it tight and heat it with a cigarette lighter or a match to anneal it so that…
She must have made it. Stay. I mean, that sounds like. Well, let me tell you.
